title: Stepwise assembly of homochiral coordination polymers based on the precursor of an enantiopure Yb3Mn6 cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as the earlier Ln analogues. LiOH·H2O (0.5 mmol) and (S)-4-amino-2-hydroxybutanoic acid (0.5 mmol) in methanol (10 mL) were stirred for 20 min; 2-hydroxybenzaldehyde (0.5 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for about 1 h at room temperature. To the resulting Schiff base (H2L−) were added Mn(OAc)2·4H2O (0.5 mmol), Yb(NO3)3·6H2O (0.25 mmol) and TEA (1.0 mmol), and the mixture was stirred for another 4 h under ambient conditions. The dark brown solution was layered with n-hexane, and block dark crystals were collected after a few days.
synthesis.time: 20 min, then about 1 h, then 4 h; crystals over a few days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by layering with n-hexane
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark brown solution layered with n-hexane; block dark crystals collected after a few days

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (2–300 K, 1000 Oe) shows χMT = 25.80 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K, close to 25.51 cm3 mol−1 K expected for six MnIII (S = 2, g = 2.0) and three YbIII (7F7/2, g = 8.7). χMT decreases slowly to about 40 K, then rises to 35.33 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, attributed to Stark depopulation and/or antiferromagnetic interactions followed by inter- and/or intracluster ferromagnetic interaction.

synthesis.procedure: Complex 4 (0.08 mmol) was dissolved in MeOH (5 mL). Sodium isonicotinate (0.2 mmol) and TEA (1.0 mmol) were added and the mixture was stirred for 30 min at ambient conditions. The dark brown solution was layered with n-hexane, and block dark crystals were collected after a few days. The main text only states that 5 was prepared by mixing 4 and isonicotinate in methanol under ambient conditions (see ESI).
synthesis.time: 30 min stirring; crystals over a few days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ambient solution reaction and layering with n-hexane
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark brown solution layered with n-hexane; block dark crystals collected after a few days

properties.summary: χMT is 25.50 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (1000 Oe), near the spin-only expectation for the Yb3Mn6 core, decreases slowly until about 40 K, then rises to 28.65 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. The profile matches cluster 4, indicating that the cluster magnetism is retained in the 2D polymer.

synthesis.procedure: Complex 4 (0.08 mmol) was dissolved in MeOH (5 mL) and DMF (5 mL). PbI2 (0.2 mmol) and NaI (0.6 mmol) were added. After stirring for 30 min, the mixture was sealed in an 18 mL Teflon-lined Parr vessel, heated at 100 °C for 12 h, and cooled to room temperature at 2 °C h−1. Dark-brown rhombic crystals were washed with DMF and MeOH. Formate is generated in situ from DMF; Pb(II) is required for yield and crystal quality but is not incorporated. The main text only states reaction of 4, NaI and in situ formate under solvothermal conditions (see ESI).

properties.summary: χMT is 26.55 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (1000 Oe), close to the value expected for six MnIII and three YbIII, decreases slowly until about 40 K, then rises to 29.34 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. The behavior is inherited from cluster 4; exchange details were not extracted.
